tools.name: search_prompts
tools.description: Search the Builder's Prompt Library (3,323 rubric-graded prompts for software delivery) by keyword. Optionally filter by delivery stage or prompt-writing grade. Returns ranked matches with slug, title, summary, stage, category, and grade. Grades and quality_score describe prompt writing, not tested

tools.name: get_prompt
tools.description: Fetch the full text and metadata of a single published prompt by its slug, including where it runs (any chat app, chat app with your code pasted in, a tool with web access, or a coding agent).

tools.name: list_stages
tools.description: List the six delivery stages in the Builder's Prompt Library and how many published prompts each contains.
